product_one_liner.value: Lumilens develops photonic interconnects that help hyperscalers expand GPU clusters and scale AI data-center infrastructure.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the navigation or footer, and no readable public pricing page was found at /pricing.

named_customers.notes: Could not verify two publicly named customers; the commercial hyperscaler customer is unnamed.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains one substantive technical/vision blog article, alongside press coverage and a founding-story video—not two qualifying engineering-authored posts.

public_docs.notes: No documentation, help-center or developer-portal link appears in the navigation or footer; no public docs/help site was located.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A careers site exists, but the complete role list could not be reviewed reliably enough to establish whether a qualifying AI/ML opening is currently available; data and analytics engineering roles were excluded.

model_provider.notes: No specific AI model or provider disclosure was located in the product/manufacturing pages, blog or privacy policy.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy describes security measures but names none of the five specified certifications or compliance frameworks.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 6, 2026. The round is reported as $700 million; the company's announcement says more than $700 million in new funding and over $900 million raised cumulatively.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 6, 2026 Series C announcement falls within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Could not verify a qualifying SDR, BDR or account-executive opening from the incomplete role list. The Customer Sales Representative posting describes customer-service and post-sales work and was not treated as qualifying.

launched_6mo.notes: Its August 6, 2026 public debut announced that its first optical interconnect product was commercially shipping into production hyperscaler AI data centers.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Neera Patel's profile dates her start as Chief Financial Officer to October 2026; the company leadership page lists her as CFO.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Business Process Manager posting explicitly names Salesforce as a CRM; this is a hiring-stack signal rather than definitive confirmation of deployment.
